## Disruption scenario

Supplier S08 delayed +4 weeks -> 3 of 4 SKUs stock out, CAD 102,027 revenue at risk; protecting against it needs CAD 47,110 of extra buffer stock.

## Logistics & landed cost (offshore vs nearshore)

Of 26 SKUs bought offshore, 7 are cheaper to source nearshore (CAD 138,633/yr saving), and 16 are worth moving if a premium of up to 3% is accepted for resilience. Moving them releases CAD 287,238 of safety-stock and in-transit inventory and cuts lead time by 4.2 weeks on average.
